violation_type.short_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child
violation_type.typical_finding: Emergency contact information for each child who is transported was unavailbe for review upon request.

finding_variants.text: Emergency contact information for each child who is transported was unavailbe for review upon request.
